hero.name: Nicolás Blanco Zappalà
hero.headline: Full Stack Engineering focused on clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
hero.description: Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building modern, high-quality web applications using TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, and SQL/NoSQL databases. Specialized in reusable component architecture, REST API integration, automated testing with Jest, and Hexagonal Architecture principles.

bento.backendDescription: Building resilient REST APIs, integrating external services, and managing data modeling with modern ORMs and ODMs.
bento.frontendDescription: Developing responsive applications with React and TypeScript, modular components, efficient state management via custom hooks, and Tailwind styling.
bento.craftsmanshipDescription: Implementing Hexagonal Architecture for long-term maintainability, automated unit and integration testing with Jest, and daily collaboration in Scrum agile environments.

experience.job1Description: Maintenance and bug fixes for Loewe's global e-commerce platform (SFCC, React, TS), and core banking module engineering for Openbank with Hexagonal Architecture and Jest.
experience.job2Description: Serverless backend on Cloudflare Workers and Hono for a B2B medtech platform (FDA/CE). Prisma/D1 modeling, KV caching, Zod contracts, and OpenAI pipelines.
experience.job3Description: Modernization and refactoring of legacy applications toward React, TypeScript, Hexagonal Architecture, and DDD in an agile Scrum environment.

projects.project1Description: LMS platform with real-time voice language tutoring, ultra-low latency, and automated multimodal evaluation.
projects.project2Description: Continuous maintenance, production bug fixes, and performance optimization for global luxury catalog and checkout flows.
projects.project3Description: Transactional and verification modules powering customer onboarding at Openbank, built with Hexagonal Architecture and Jest.
